heroHeadline: Russia's Gasoline Output Falls to ~70% of Demand as Refinery Strikes Persist
heroSubtitle: Fresh drone strikes disable Yaroslavl's Slavneft-YANOS and Samara's Kuibyshev refineries as national gasoline production runs roughly 35,000 tonnes/day short of demand, deepening the second nationwide shortage wave
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
